main_issue: Who completes Agent D's unfinished pitch section by Thursday while D attends the wake: D working tonight versus A taking over with help from B and C.

A-B.evidence: A asks B to review the section (turn 9); B agrees to review tomorrow afternoon (turn 10), and A thanks B (turn 11).

A-C.evidence: C first says they cannot do D's section (turn 5). C then agrees to help with slides after finishing their own part (turns 12, 19), and A accepts (turn 18).

A-D.evidence: A rejects D's offer to work tonight (turns 7, 14). D yields with 'Okay, Agent A. If you're sure' and leaves it with the team (turns 15, 20). A replies 'We'll handle it' (turn 21).

B-C.evidence: Both say they cannot take on more (turns 4, 5). Later both go along with A's plan (turns 10, 12). They never address each other.

B-D.evidence: B says they can't take on more (turn 4). B later agrees to review (turn 10). D ends by leaving it to the group (turn 20), so there is no direct exchange between them.

C-D.evidence: C says they cannot do D's section (turn 5). D worries about C's lateness (turn 15), and C replies 'Don't worry about my part' (turn 17). D then thanks everyone (turn 20).
